vo.next_text: Station 11AP2 suggests 6 percent. With a 10 percent threshold set, the table still shows 6, and it always will.

vo.next_text: The threshold is applied only in the Push Changes dialog, and to what is sent to Lynx. Never to the table.

vo.next_text: This is the disagreement, and it is intentional.

vo.text: This is the disagreement, and it is intentional.
vo.previous_text: Open Push Changes and the same station shows its original value and the rewritten one side by side, with the banner counting how many rows were affected.
vo.next_text: Set to zero skips the station: Lynx receives 0 percent. Set to the minimum threshold value lifts the suggestion up to the threshold, so the station still gets a short run.

vo.text: Set to zero skips the station: Lynx receives 0 percent. Set to the minimum threshold value lifts the suggestion up to the threshold, so the station still gets a short run.
vo.previous_text: This is the disagreement, and it is intentional.
vo.next_text: They are opposite behaviours from the same number.

vo.text: They are opposite behaviours from the same number.
vo.previous_text: Set to zero skips the station: Lynx receives 0 percent. Set to the minimum threshold value lifts the suggestion up to the threshold, so the station still gets a short run.
vo.next_text: Exclude Zeros is available only under the second option. A station whose suggestion is a true zero stays at zero, instead of being lifted to the threshold.

vo.text: Exclude Zeros is available only under the second option. A station whose suggestion is a true zero stays at zero, instead of being lifted to the threshold.
vo.previous_text: They are opposite behaviours from the same number.
vo.next_text: Without it, a station that needs no water gets a small run anyway.

vo.text: Without it, a station that needs no water gets a small run anyway.
vo.previous_text: Exclude Zeros is available only under the second option. A station whose suggestion is a true zero stays at zero, instead of being lifted to the threshold.
vo.next_text: A threshold of zero turns the whole thing off, and the option group is disabled with it.
